title: Donald Trump controls Resorts International

tellings.quote: For a brief period, he was the guy basically in charge of it for a for a year or so.

plain: Donald Trump was, for a year or so, basically the man in charge of a company called Resorts International, with ties to the US and the Bahamas. A guest named Jason Simosa tells Michels this without naming a source, as one link in a chain he draws between the UFO cover-up and a secret society.
